title: Walk Like That
style: Hip-hop trap anthem with a laid-back swung pocket, crisp hi-hat rolls, heavy 808 slides, and clap snaps on the backbeat; verse rides sparse drums and a rubbery bass line, pre-chorus strips to half-time with filtered synth stabs, chorus hits with gang vocal chants and a bright hook lead, bridge drops to voice and bass before a final lift. Lead vocal stays close-mic and cocky in the verses, doubled on the hook with ad-lib throws and panned responses. Vinyl crackle into the intro, reverse swell into the pre-chorus, and a short riser into each chorus. Bright, punchy, and wide in the low end.
